etsy.title: Sensory Room Sign, Calm Space Door Poster, Autism Classroom Wall Art, Therapy Room Decor
etsy.description:
A soft Sensory Room sign marking a calm space to rest, move, and reset.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang at the entrance of a home or school sensory room, or a therapy office sensory space.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical, therapy, or educational advice. Thank you for supporting a small, neurodivergent-run shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy sensory room signs range from cheap printable labels and banners to wooden or neon door signs; a soft printed poster sits between.
Some are 'overstimulated, do not approach' warning signs; this one is gentle and welcoming.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon options are 'Sensory Safe Zone' 8x12 aluminum signs, MDF autism signs and therapy door hangers.

research.notes: Title rewritten so 'sensory' appears once. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with physical signs and did not separate physical poster prices.
